title: NewsPerspectiveUpdateRequest
description: news.perspective-update-request@1: bodies of news.perspective.update on OpenVibe.News (editors). POST /api/v1/stories/:id/perspectives { label, description? } adds an editor-labelled perspective (labels are written by editors, never generated; 422 perspective.no_label, 422 perspective.label_too_long over 80 characters; the description is cut to 500). PUT /api/v1/stories/:id/sources/:item/perspective { perspective } puts an attached source in a perspective (per_…) or in none (null or absent; 404 story.source_not_attached, 404 perspective.not_found). DELETE /api/v1/stories/:id/perspectives/:pid takes no body.

label.description: At most 80 characters once whitespace is collapsed.
